request.deadline: Three-month liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; other final delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent safety mechanisms
Composable FIRE and ICE Cardano-native assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, and launch-readiness review
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement
request.what: Fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer by Sundial Protocol and Charms.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for a planning budget of approximately USD 2.0 million.

The request is split into two separated pools of approximately USD 1.0 million each, one for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity and one for delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution.
Pool 1 launch liquidity will be treasury-supported and treasury-owned, with profits, yield, and returns returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly.
Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve backing FIRE and ICE, with a target initial reserve ratio of 5.0x and safety zones that constrain minting and redemption below stated reserve-ratio thresholds.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-backed claim, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset, both intended as composable Cardano-native primitives.

The proposal commits to dashboards, monthly governance reports, audit allocation, milestone gating, pause rules, refund conditions, ADA price protection, and fund separation as accountability controls.

Intersect is proposed as interim fund administrator, but its role is subject to confirmation and final agreement, with an alternative administrator to be nominated if Intersect does not confirm within 30 days of enactment.

The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that failure to fund Alchemy would leave Bitcoin-backed structured exposure to consolidate on other chains and off-chain markets.
The proposal cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle as evidence that demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is real and growing.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and proposes mitigation through overcollateralization, audits, modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, disclosures, and pause rules.

summary: The document requests 10,000,000 ada for a BTCfi infrastructure package centered on FIRE/ICE assets, shared BTC reserve mechanics, launch liquidity, dashboards, integrations, audits, reporting, and administrator oversight, with several treasury-protection commitments but many adoption and market-need assertions resting on proposer argument or externally checkable references.
